content.title: Anonymous Mode
content.description: Enables Server Side Anonymization, preventing the User IP Address and Network User ID from being collectoed. Values in the atomic events table if the header is present: network_userid: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, user_id & domain_userid: null, IP address: unknown.
